Name: Vevios
Description:
The Elderly & chronically ill are exposed to high risks every day, due to major flaws in their safety alarms — an intolerable situation for some of society’s most vulnerable groups. Their freedom is limited, as they cannot safely rely on their lifeline to communicate with the home care that their safety alarm is supposed to provide. Problems that lead to worry and even to casualties. 
Through personal work experience in elderly care and industrial design, we limited the major problems of today's safety alarm to; (C) communication, (E)ergonomics, and (D) design. 
We have developed Vevios, a mobile safety alarm that increases the quality of life, by providing safety and freedom for users. C: Vevios is simply a smartphone in a discreet bracelet, an (eSIM) enables direct two-way communication and global positioning. E: Vevios is triggered through the patented panic-grip which reduces false alarms as well as provides the user visual and vibrating feedback through the alarming process. D: It is simple and clean in its design, to fit a wide user group. Our goal is to give users a safe and active life.
Follow our journey to bring Vevios to the market to provide a better life for exposed users.

Name: IDS, Information Delivery Systems

IDS is a leading provider of Inter-Carrier Billing and Legal Data Retention solutions, with a strong market presence in Sweden and users across Denmark, Norway, Finland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Austria, the Netherlands, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Greece.

As a specialized product company, IDS develops, supports, and delivers the iServ product platform, designed to transform raw data into actionable business intelligence. iServ provides organizations with efficient, structured access to critical information, ensuring accurate billing and regulatory compliance in complex telecom environments.

With over 30 years of expertise in data warehousing and business intelligence—particularly in the Information, Communications, and Technology (ICT) sector—IDS has continuously refined its solutions to meet the evolving demands of telecom operators and enterprises. This extensive experience, spanning both product development and real-world operational needs, led to the creation of iServ. Launched in 2007, iServ was built from the ground up, free from legacy constraints, leveraging cutting-edge technology to ensure scalability, security, and high performance.

iServ is engineered with a strong focus on user-friendliness, operational efficiency, and ease of administration, making it a preferred choice for telecom providers seeking accurate inter-carrier settlements, cost allocation, and data processing solutions.

What sets IDS apart is its unique combination of:

Deep expertise in telecommunications data management
Executive-level experience in operating telecom networks
A strong, entrepreneurial approach to product innovation
Headquartered in Luxembourg, with its primary R&D center in Stockholm, IDS has established international partnerships with leading consulting firms and system integrators. These alliances ensure rapid implementation and global support for iServ customers

Vi är med andra ord inte en reklambyrå som sätter en logo på en tote bag  – utan vi tar fram produkter från scratch och ser till att de håller ett vackert och unikt designspråk men som också är i enighet med den höga svenska standarden på kvalité och säkerhet. Vi brukar säga att t.o.m. iPhone tillverkas i Kina och för att få fram en högkvalitativ produkt från Kina så krävs det goda kunskaper inom sourcing, ett team som förstår sig på kvalité, men framförallt tydliga rutiner och detaljerade tekniska ritningar och instruktioner till fabrik. Dessutom utför vi pre-shipment inspections samt labbtester i de projekt som kräver extra noggrann kvalitetscheck eller godkända certifikat. Name: eSite Power Systems AB
Description:
eSite Power Systems is a Swedish technology company specialising in telecom site power management systems.  With over 20 years of experience designing and manufacturing its award-winning eSite product, eSite Power Systems is a leader in its field and has pioneered the deployment of sustainable green power infrastructure across Africa and Asia.

eSiteTM x10 is the world’s first power system purpose-built for telecom sites.  Designed as a maintenance-free, ruggedized and sealed unit, eSite’s outdoor rectification system, passive cooling and protective soft power switching secure 24/7 performance in even the harshest of environments.

Intelligent power harvesting from any combination of solar, grid and genset makes eSite x10 the most versatile system on the market today .  And its fully integrated eSite Tools remote management system captures all site data, enabling KPI reporting, alarm management and energy optimisation of eSite networks.  eSite x10 is the future of telecom site power.

eSite Power Systems is headquartered in Sweden and has additional offices in Nigeria and South Africa.

Name: Telpartner A/S
Description:
Telpartner blev grundlagt tilbage i 2003 af Lars Knudsen og Michael Carlsen. De kommer med mere end 25 års erfaring inden for Telecom markedet. Begge har været med til at drive markedet i Danmark, med særlig fokus på Telecom og DAS-løsninger. 

Ved opstarten havde vi to fokusområder: materialer til opbygning af mobilnetværket i Danmark og DAS-løsninger. Vi har derfor i dag stor erfaring med at sikre indendørs mobildækning i alle former for bygninger. Det sker via vores skræddersyede og komplette DAS-løsninger. Vi skaber indendørs mobildækning, om det så gælder i jeres kontorbygning, supermarked, tunnel, parkeringskælder eller andet. Vi går ikke på kompromis med kvaliteten og vi brænder for at optimere mobildækningen for jer. Vi lever for, at I og jeres kunder altid kan være online og have dækning. Vi overvåger derfor vores DAS-anlæg, så vi kan sikre problemfri dækning hele tiden. 

Ved at samarbejde med os, får I løsninger, der virker. Vi er med gennem hele processen, så I møder en tryghed i hele samarbejdet. 

Besøg vores hjemmeside, og få et større indblik i vores kompetencer og se hvordan vi kan hjælpe jer.

Telekombranschen går mer och mer åt det automatiserade hållet, där robotröster, talsvarstjänster och långa kötider blir allt vanligare. Det tycker vi på +46 är fel, så vi valde att gå en helt annan väg. Så tänker vi – och det är så vi hedrar Sveriges alla småföretagare.

Name: ECO-eNET
Description: The main goal of the ECO-eNET project is to establish confluent networks as a scalable platform for 6G networks. Finally, the main findings will be disseminated to key stakeholders in the ecosystem.

Industry organization MORGAN is a professional network for organisations working to develop and enable mobile content services in Sweden. Together we work to deepen knowledge, regulate the market, and give each of our members a better opportunity to shape the future in our field.

Morgan defines the services:

Bulk SMS (A2P – Messaging) means when a company send a large amount of SMS to a target group or to individuals. For example notification of a package or a reminder of a doctor ́s visit.

Premium SMS (charging SMS/Carrier Billing) means when a content provider offers a service via SMS and charges for this service.

Industry organization MORGAN is a gathering of companies active in and around the Swedish mobile service industry. Our members are found within the content, entertainment, media and corporate sector. Our purpose is to act on behalf on our member to raise the interest in mobility in media and to potential customers and consumers, as well as being a communication mediator between the players in the industry.

Goal
MORGAN will act to create a fair and interesting market for all the players in the mobile value chain. By doing so both companies and consumers can benefit from value added and entertaining services. A membership in MORGAN also gives your company a stamp showing that you are complying with fair, ethical and commercially correct regulations.

How we work in MORGAN
The work at MORGAN is mostly done in different working groups gathered on initiatives from the members. These groups argue for both short and long term issues with a clear goal to be proactive and to drive industry development in the right direction. Morgan also serves as a discussion partner for the industry and a body to which regulatory authorities can turn to for input on a proposed measure prior to being considered by the government.

Name: TDC Song

The story of TDC has been termed by many as a true business adventure that started small with only 22 subscribers. In mid-2011, TDC A/S had 8.99 million customer relations in Denmark and abroad.

Name: SmartTrust
Description:
The Company

SmartTrust is a global leader in SIM and Mobile Device Management software designed to provide mobile network operators improved understanding of their subscribers and efficient management of the SIM cards and devices on their network.

With our innovative technologies, mobile operators can implement new services quickly and efficiently, and gain knowledge about the needs of subscribers.

Over 200 mobile network operators rely on us for SIM device and value added service management as well as dynamic roaming steering. Our customers range in size from new start-ups with fewer than 100,000 subscribers to well-established operators with more than 75 million subscribers. Our technology touches more than 1.5 billion people every day and has been implemented by all major SIM vendors.

SmartTrust's origins go back to 1974. We have been delivering solutions for SIM management since 1991 and device management since 2002, building on our success by pioneering Over-the-Air (OTA) technology for managing SIM cards, handsets and mobile value added services.

By delivering the software tools to manage all of the equipment - SIM and device - in the hands of the subscriber, our systems enable service providers to realize the full potential of their businesses.

SmartTrust is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden with regional sales and support offices around the globe.

SmartTrust is a part of the Giesecke & Devrient Group.

Name: CellRebel

Name: YouCall Sverige AB
Description:
YouCall Sverige AB är ett kontaktcenter som främst erbjuder telefonbaserade tjänster till kunder i hela Sverige och uppdragen spänner över olika typer av svarstjänster till avancerade IT-supportuppdrag och fastighetsjourer med tillgänglighet dygnet runt.  

Under 1980-talet etablerades grunden till dagens YouCall, då som en mindre aktör inom driftlarm och felanmälan men 1996 så fick verksamheten större tyngd då SOS Alarm gick in som ägare, tillsammans med Piteå Näringsfastigheter. 

Vår majoritetsägare är SOS Alarm, en erkänd aktör inom trygghetstjänster och dem  i ryggen har vi närmare 900 kollegor på 15 orter i Sverige.  YouCall’s starka ägare i kombination med mångårig specialisering har gett oss gedigen erfarenhet av trygghetstjänster för kunder med höga anspråk. 

Våra uppdragsgivare ställer ofta krav på sekretess, exempelvis hjälper vi aktörer inom hälso- och sjukvård. 
YouCall arbetar alltid med hög integritet i enlighet med väl utarbetade rutiner. 

Dessutom har vi en hög tillgänglighet då vi har öppet dygnet runt, året om och våra serviceoperatörer kan arbeta både i våra kunders system men vi har även egna system som kan användas om kunden inte har ett eget. Vi kommunicerar via telefon, e-post, sms, webb och chatt.

Idag är vi cirka 50 årsanställda medarbetare med huvudkontoret på Furunäsets Företagsby i Piteå, som oavsett frågor, tid eller ärende finns vi redo att bidra till framgångsrik service.

Sammanfattningsvis kan man säga att YouCall inte är något traditionellt callcenter, utan ett avancerat, samhällsnyttigt kontaktcenter och med våra trygga ägare, vår flexibla organisation och våra unika tjänster så åtar vi oss speciellt kvalificerade tjänster som kräver ett extra stort förtroende.

Name: Easypartner Östergötland

Description: Vi jobbar med att skräddarsy lösningar åt våra underbara företag här i Sverige. Vi erbjuder allt ifrån olika abonnemangs samt växellösningar, till hårdvaror, kontorsmaterial och allt inom copy print. Istället för att begära in flera offerter från olika leverantörer kan man hos oss på Phonely AB få de offerter man vill ha från ett och samma ställe.

Name: Conveneer AB
Description:
Our product Mikz is a web technology that enables various web applications to be easily mashed with mobile phones and other computing devices.

Based on a pay-as-you-go billing model, Mikz offers a turn-key solution for making mobile devices accessible in real-time via a customizable web API and normal URL addressing like http://joe.mikz.me. Mikz supports over the air provisioning of web API plug-ins, applications and media.

Name: VMI Systems
Description: VMI Systems offers customized communication solutions for service terminals such as ATM’s, Kiosks and Vending-machines.

Name: NewCom AB
Description: NewCom är ett företag som jobbar med kommunikativa lösningar åt små, medelstora och stora företag. Den typ av kommunikation vi lägger störst fokus på är den kommunikation som sker i det mobila och fasta nätet. Vi vet att just denna typ av kommunikation kommer att öka kraftfullt. Vi lägger tonvikten vid både terminaler, mjukvarulösningar och tjänster så som office extension och säkerhets lösningar. Vi har ett utarbetat säkerhetsprogram som kommer att kunna implementeras i företagens säkerhetslösningar. Med över 50 års branscherfarenhet samt ett brett kunnande anser vi oss vara en partner med stort kunnande och stor pålitlighet. Vi jobbar med alla kommunikations operatörer på den Svenska marknaden och med de största grossisterna.

Name: Avtronix Sweden AB
Description:
The technological revolution has become a rapid technological evolution. 
Every day changes, in which old solutions are replaced completely or partly new, take place. 
New ideas and opportunities are effectively changes the "old" patterns after only a couple of years. 

A strong trend today is the use of videoconferencing. 
This trend is assessed to soon create a parcel that will completely change the conditions for the way to conference, and also ease the burden of travel for the individual. 

Infrastructure with the bandwidth is in place, more and more people are ready to work online, and many realize that there is a huge waste of resources compared to this new green technology. 

Avtronix concept is to be a leader in this change and make this shift possible. 
Our contribution is to provide competent and optimized solutions for all our customers, large and small. 

Avtronix Sweden AB, exclusive distributor for Emblaze-VCON products in Sweden.

Name: WELLSON Consulting AB
Description: WELLSON Consulting AB is founded and run by Andreas Wells and has two legs. One is the consultancy  services where Andreas helps projects mainly in the Telecom sector and Data center bulid out as a PMP. The other leg has a focus as an entreprenor in new inovations.

Name: Laproj AB
Description: Laproj AB is a consultant Company mainly focusing on the Telecom industry and manufacturing. We are experts doing research for one of the main players among the Telecom network suppliers. The Company was founded in september 2013 and has grown rapidly in 6 months. Laproj AB offers Senior Project management, System design, Software development, Network simulations and Production management.

Name: Rest2U AB
Description:
Rest2U 
Bringing you the right telecom solutions 
....when your goal is to cut your cost and your ambition is to form and positioning your company as an environment friendly competitior.

We are a small but well established service company with focus on future solutions, which benefits our global environment and your budget.

We only take on assignments were we through discussions have secured that we can provide the right and optimal solution 2 U. 

Our vision:
Keep it simple, keep it clean and let us provide the Rest2U

Name: DinTel AB
Description: DinTel består i grund och botten av sammanslagningen mellan 2 olika entreprenörsgrupper som tillsammans har lång erfarenhet att telekomlösningar, främst för företag. Målet var att slå ihop förmågan av att leverera marknadens främsta lösningar inom såväl data som tal och växellösningar. Sammangåendet har skett mellan en av de största dataleverantörerna och en av de största återförsäljarna av tal och telefonväxel i Sverige, detta resulterade i DinTel.

Name: Mobot AB
Description:
Om oss
Vi levererar en telefonilösning som faktiskt fungerar som man kan förvänta sig.

Vår vision
”Mobot skall nu och i framtiden vara det kundnära företaget som levererar framtidssäkra telefonilösningar oavsett teknologi.”

Beskrivning
Vi är ett tjänsteföretag som tillhandahåller en modern virtuell telefonilösning. Produktfamiljen består av enkla paketet för det lilla företaget till starta och växa för det medelstora till stora företaget med mer avancerad krav på sin telefoni. De stora fördelarna blir ett flexibelt, lättanvänt och stabilt system som därtill är kostnadsbesparande.

Läs mer på http://mobot.se/om-oss

Name: Frontgrade Communication AB
Description: Frontgrade är en Skandinavisk distributör på bredbands- och telekom-marknaden. Vi erbjuder tjänster och produkter inom IT & Telecom med en viss tyngdpunkt och kompetens inom radiobaserade lösningar.

Name: Eltek Energy AB
Description: Eltek is a world leader in high-efficiency power electronics and energy conversion within telecom and industrial applications.

Name: Ventelo Sverige
Description: Ventelo Sverige AB var ett svenskt IT- och telekommunikationsbolag som under 2011 uppgick i AllTele. Ventelo Sverige AB bedrev verksamhet i Sverige inom fast och mobil telefoni samt internet- och datatjänster för företag.

Name: Glädjens IT & Telekom
Description:
Glädjens IT & Telekom hjälper företag att växa genom smarta och kostnadseffektiva IT- och telekomlösningar. Vi vänder oss till små och medelstora verksamheter över hela Sverige – från nystartade bolag som behöver sin första mobilväxel till etablerade organisationer som vill optimera hela sin kommunikationsstruktur.

Sedan 1985 har vi utvecklats i takt med tekniken. Vi började med att installera och programmera några av Sveriges första mobiltelefoner för företag och erbjöd tidigt handsfree och GPS-lösningar i fordon. Med åren har vi byggt upp en stark kompetens inom mobilabonnemang, växelsystem, IT-lösningar och fordonsteknik – alltid med fokus på att minska kostnader och frigöra resurser för våra kunder.

Vi har hjälpt hundratals företag att spara pengar genom skräddarsydda abonnemangsavtal, flexibla växlar och proaktiv support. Våra växellösningar anpassas efter företagets storlek och behov, från mindre team till stora organisationer med hundratals användare. Samtidigt erbjuder vi fordonstekniska lösningar som ökar säkerheten, förbättrar logistikflöden och skapar full kontroll över fordonsflottor.

Det som gör oss unika är vårt helhetsperspektiv. Vi kombinerar telekom, IT och fordonsteknik för att ge företag en komplett kommunikationsplattform som är både enkel att använda och framtidssäker. Hos oss får du inte bara en leverantör – du får en partner som lär känna din verksamhet och aktivt letar efter sätt att effektivisera, sänka kostnader och skapa mervärde.

Det kan vara allt från finansiering, till olika servicekoncept eller tjänster som hjälper er att hålla koll på era enheter och göra ert mobilanvändande säkert.

Name: Capana Settlements
Description: Capana is a software provider, developing tools for handling the entire B2B/B2B2B/B2B2C billing life cycle. From gathering, decoding and enhancing transaction data to aggregation and distribution for partner and end-user billing.

Name: Alltechx
Description: Technology is in constant and rapid development, and has become an essential part of our daily life. It's getting harder and harder to keep up. Alltechx' mission is to handle the problems that technology sometimes brings along. Whether the computer feels sluggish, or something isn't working properly, there is always a solution. Alltechx offers a broad selection of services that facilitates everyday life, and finds solutions to everything tech-related.

Name: Forest Star Networks
Description: Forest Star Networks is a licenced full-service fixed and mobile network communications provider. FSN ‘s unmatched operational efficiency, industry expertise, and technical innovation, enable it to offer a variety of origination and termination products, services, and customized network solutions. FSN is the carrier of choice serving a range of all communication service providers, from international tier one carriers to local and domestic CLECs, ISPs, and broadband providers.

Name: Telero Distribution AB
Description:
Distributing audio and videoconferencing solutions to resellers in Scandinavia.
We represent companies like Phoenix, ClearOne, Konftel, Vidicode and Arctic Connect.
Telero can supply any kind of equipment for the audiopart of a Teleconferencing solution. Large or small rooms.

Name: Telia
Description:
Our 15 000 talented colleagues serve millions of customers every day in one of the world’s most connected regions. With a strong connectivity base, we’re the hub in the digital ecosystem, empowering people, companies and societies to stay in touch with everything that matters 24/7/365 - on their terms. 

Our goal is to make Telia better for customers, employees, owners and societies in the Nordics and the Baltics.

Name: EXFO
Description:
EXFO develops smarter test, measurement and monitoring solutions for the global communications industry. We are trusted advisors to fixed and mobile network operators, hyperscalers and leaders in the manufacturing, development and research sector. They count on us to deliver superior visibility and insights into network performance, service reliability and user experience. Building on nearly 40 years of innovation, EXFO’s unique blend of equipment, software and services enable faster, more confident transformations related to 5G, cloud-native and fiber optic networks.

To find out more, visit www.EXFO.com and follow us on our blog - https://www.exfo.com/en/resources/blog/

Name: Sandvine (Now AppLogic Networks)
Description: This page will be retired on June 30. Please follow our new page @AppLogic Networks for all news and updates.:

Name: Infinera
Description:
Infinera is now part of Nokia.

Infinera is revolutionizing telecommunications networks with innovative, industry-leading connectivity solutions. Our offerings include high-end subcomponent technology, systems for network infrastructure, automation software, advanced optical compound semiconductor manufacturing, & professional services. As a global supplier, we empower mobile service providers, internet content providers, cloud operators, submarine operators, governments & enterprises to scale network bandwidth, boost service innovation, and automate network operations. We are committed to continuously expanding and enhancing our world-class offerings to meet the changing needs of our customers. 

Our connectivity solutions are powered by the world’s best embedded & pluggable optical engines, which are designed, developed & manufactured in Infinera’s U.S.-based optical semiconductor fabrication center and are application-optimized for edge, metro, long-haul, and submarine transport networks. Our agile, open, compact & modular networking platforms enable network operators to rapidly and easily take advantage of best-in-class technology. Our software automation solutions optimize traffic flows and automate workloads to enable network operators to cost-effectively deliver secure bandwidth to their customers where and when needed. With these solutions, our goal is to create a connected world with unlimited bandwidth for everyone – everywhere, always, and instantly.


What Inspires Us? 
A connected world with unlimited bandwidth for everyone – everywhere, always & instantly. 

What Motivates Us?
Delivering innovative and impactful coherent optical technologies and open optical solutions that unlock new value for our customers. 

What Drives Us?
To be a valued investment for our shareholders’ money, our customers’ CapEx and our employees’ time by delivering an unrivaled customer experience from an inclusive culture of innovation for our customers.

Name: Ericsson Software
Description:
On this channel, we discuss the convergence of cloud software and services to prepare for mobile networks of the future. Join the conversation to connect, engage and get inspired by new telecom developments and insights in #Cloud, #CoreNetwork, #BSS, #AI, #Automation, #Orchestration, #Analytics and more. 

Rules of the house available here: https://www.ericsson.com/en/newsroom/rules-of-the-house

Let’s #ImaginePossible together!

Name: Tele2
Description: Tele2 is a Nordic and Baltic telecom operator built on a strong challenger culture. Since 1993, Tele2 has challenged established norms in the telecom industry by making connectivity simpler, smarter and more cost efficient for customers. Tele2 provides mobile, fixed connectivity, TV and streaming services, as well as IoT solutions, to consumers and businesses across the Nordic and Baltic region. Tele2 is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. In 2025, Tele2 generated revenue of SEK 29.9 billion. For the latest news and definitions of measures, visit tele2.com.For latest news and definitions of measures, please see our website at tele2.com.

Name: GlobalConnect
Description: GlobalConnect is one of the leading digital infrastructure and data communication providers in the Nordic region, driving more than half of all data traffic in and out of the Nordics. GlobalConnect delivers fiber-based broadband services to more than 907,000 private consumers and end-to-end connectivity solutions to 30,000 B2B customers via its 244,000 kilometer fiber network across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Germany and Finland. GlobalConnect employs approximately 1,800 people and had a turnover of SEK 8.1 billion in 2024.

Name: Arelion
Description:
Arelion is a leading light in global connectivity services. We’ve been keeping the world connected since 1993 and today our global IP backbone, AS1299, is ranked number one in the world. Our network spans Europe, North America, and Asia with 77,000 km of optical fiber and 1,700 MPLS endpoints. Our award-winning customer service team supports our expansive customer base, who rely on us for their business-critical services. 

Discover more at www.arelion.com 
X (Twitter): @ArelionCompany
Podcast: https://www.arelion.com/knowledge-hub/the-connectivity-podcast

Name: 3 Sverige
Description:
We are Three. We are the underdog that challenges the whole Swedish telecommarket. Since the start in 2003 our main priority have been to develop our products and our network so that our two million customers can have the best mobile experience as possible.

We are convinced that our culture is the main ingredient in our recipe to success. A culture created by everyone working at Three.

Name: Polystar | Elisa Industriq
Description:
Polystar is a global leader in smart, data-driven assurance and automation for telecommunications operators. Its solutions transform complex network data into operational intelligence that drives business results. Polystar enables communications service providers (CSPs) to enhance the customer experience and achieve optimal operational efficiency through real-time, actionable insights and pragmatic automation, powered by AI.

Trusted by more than 100 CSPs across 55 countries, Polystar collaborates with operators to optimize their multi-vendor networks – cloud-native and on-premises. 

Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden with a worldwide presence, Polystar is part of Elisa Industriq, a global leader in software solutions for operational intelligence that enhances industrial knowledge with AI innovation. 

Polystar is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2013 certified, reflecting its commitment to quality management and information security.

Name: Enea AB
Description:
Enea is a global specialist in advanced telecom and cybersecurity software, with a vision to make the world’s communications safer and more efficient. Dedicated to innovation and security, our solutions connect, optimize, and protect communications between people, companies, and connected things worldwide. We serve 160+ communication service providers across 100+ countries, with more than 3 billion people relying on Enea technologies every day.

Enea has strengthened its product portfolio and global market position by integrating a number of acquisitions, including Qosmos, Openwave Mobility, Aptilo Networks, and AdaptiveMobile Security. 

Enea is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden and is listed on NASDAQ Stockholm.

Name: Hexatronic
Description:
Connectivity creates opportunity. Hexatronic delivers future-ready fiber solutions for critical infrastructure, from telecom networks to harsh environments and data centers. Our systems are built to last, designed to scale, and supported by expert training and field services. In close collaboration with our customers, we shape solutions that strengthen communities and drive innovation in a connected world. 

Join us in building a connected future!

Name: Telenor IoT
Description:
For more than 20 years, we’ve helped enterprises connect and manage millions of devices worldwide. The result is long-term partnerships, reliable and secure operations, and customer satisfaction that consistently ranks among the highest in the industry.

Backed by the stability of Telenor Group, we combine technical leadership with deep in-house IoT expertise. Our customers are supported by experienced specialists who work hands-on, stay close, and take responsibility from design to scale.

As Telenor Group’s dedicated IoT organization, we support global leaders such as Volvo, Scania, Hitachi, Verisure and Great Wall Motors in building secure, scalable and future-ready IoT solutions.

Name: Network Innovations
Description:
As technology solution integrators, we enable our customers to conduct some of the most important work on the planet – from the front office to the remote mission or field operation. Our customers depend on us for honest advice, a wide array of innovative offerings, and superior service to ensure their worlds are connected securely and seamlessly.

Meeting Your Mission. With Passion. 

Operating globally, Network Innovations headquarters from Calgary, Canada with regional offices in Tampa/Fort Lauderdale/Houston/San Diego/Seattle/Kodiak/Dutch Harbor-USA, the Netherlands, /Sweden-EU, England-UK, Singapore & Australia (Sydney, Perth). NI also maintains an extensive network of more than 200 partners operating globally throughout the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Name: TXO
Description:
TXO is a global leader in transforming technology for a more sustainable future. We enable organisations worldwide to optimise and transform technology across its entire lifecycle, accelerating sustainability, unlocking value, and delivering measurable environmental impact.

Founded in 2005 as Transmission Only, TXO has evolved from enabling networks to stay connected into a global circular economy partner supporting sustainable technology transformation.

Our service offering combines product solutions with engineering expertise across field engineering, network services, spare parts management services (SPMS), test and repair, infrastructure rationalisation, asset recovery and urban mining, supported by complementary capabilities.

We integrate every stage of the technology lifecycle into a single circular, fully managed approach that helps organisations improve performance, extend asset life and achieve measurable environmental and operational outcomes.

Supporting customers in more than 140 countries, sustainability is the foundation of everything we do. Backed by TowerBrook Capital Partners’ impact strategy, TXO continues to expand globally while remaining committed to its circular economy principles.

Name: Syntronic - A Global Design House
Description:
Syntronic is a engineering design house specializing in the design and development of electronics, electro-mechanics, embedded and IT software. As an established engineering design house, we provide valuable contribution to your product and test development as well as help you achieve the desired product time-to-market cost-effectively. We also offer solutions where we undertake turn-key responsibility of product development and system integration from idea to complete system delivery. We adopt the latest technologies in electronics design and software development worldwide.

Among our customers and partners are some of the world’s most technique-intensive businesses and organizations in sectors such as telecommunication, automotive, industrial and medtech. In designing to satisfy customers’ needs, we focus on quality, competence and ease of production.

Name: Icomera
Description:
For over two decades, Icomera has been the world’s leading provider of onboard connectivity solutions. We enable millions of passengers to connect every day with the fastest, most reliable and secure Internet connection currently available to a moving vehicle. 

Today our networks have the power to fully integrate tens of thousands of vehicles into the cloud, paving the way for a vibrant new world of smart, connected transportation. In the future, our network connectivity will empower a bold new generation of safer, more efficient and sustainable transport solutions. We aim to be the partner of choice for those on the smart, connected journey that lies ahead. 

A wholly owned subsidiary of Equans, Icomera is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with key offices in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, the United States and Canada.

Name: Swedish Post and Telecom Authority
Description:
Post- och telestyrelsen (PTS) arbetar för att alla i Sverige ska ha tillgång till bra telefoni, bredband och post.

The Swedish Post and Telecom Authority (PTS) works to ensure that everyone in Sweden shall have access to efficient, affordable and secure communications services.

http://www.pts.se
http://blogg.pts.se
http://twitter.com/PTSse

Name: HAUD
Description:
HAUD provides mobile network operators with a complete service to safeguard A2P revenues and enhance network security.

HAUD’s portfolio of modular services and solutions can be deployed in custom configurations, providing operators with flexible and robust protection to meet precise requirements.

Headquartered in Sweden and with representative offices globally, HAUD offers traffic audits, system trials and various pricing models. 

Visit www.haud.com for further information.

Name: Tele2 IoT
Description: IoT isn't about the industry, it's about the challenges you want to solve. Tele2 IoT is a team of friendly and dedicated IoT experts working to ensure that you get the most from your IoT solution. We have the products and the platforms required for your success - and more importantly we have the knowledge and dedication from top to bottom that offers you support throughout your IoT Journey.

Name: Telavox
Description:
We are a mobile operator only for businesses, specializing in simplifying and innovating telephony. Our app combines fixed and mobile telephony, PBX, AI, collaboration and integrations, all designed to improve productivity and streamline communication.

With an intuitive user experience and flexible features, Telavox empowers companies of all sizes to communicate better, work smarter, and stay in control.

Name: Sigma Connectivity
Description:
Sigma Connectivity is a tech house with the mission to innovate and create value and growth with connected solutions and devices, which makes them and their partners unique.

With one of Europe’s most advanced design, test, and verification labs, they meet their clients’ specific needs of bringing smart, connected products to market.

They have, since being acquired from Sony Mobile in 2013, successfully increased the number of active engineers from 180 to over 700, and are operating from 12 sites worldwide.

No industry is too complex to connect!

Name: Bahnhof AB (Publ)
Description: Bahnhof AB is a Sweden-based Internet Service Provider that offers data transmission and broadband services. The Company’s activities are structured into three main business areas: broadband services for private customers; high capacity broadband services and tailor-made solutions for companies, and server operations that include information technology (IT) solutions, which are offered via data centers and targeted at the corporations’ sector. Bahnhof AB is primarily active in Sweden. The Company is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Name: Relacom
Description: RELACOM IS NOW OPERATING UNDER THE NAME ONECO. Follow us @OneCo Sverige.

Name: Telgea
Description:
Telgea provides unified international mobile connectivity for multinational corporations across multiple countries. We eliminate the complexity of managing multiple telecom vendors by integrating separate country MVNOs into a single platform with one contract.

Our enterprise clients get local mobile plans in each market with low cost data delivered through one provider relationship. This means lower overall cost, simplified management, and consistent service quality across your global operations.

Built for companies that need reliable mobile connectivity across borders without the operational overhead of coordinating multiple carriers, multiple contracts, and multiple billing systems.

Name: Transtema
Description:
Transtema är ett av Nordens ledande företag när det gäller att installera, underhålla och sköta driften av olika typer av kommunikationsinfrastruktur. Vi finns på 33 orter i Norden.
Vi hjälper dig med alla typer av nät – mobilt, fiber, energilösningar, laddstationer och el. Vårt erbjudande omfattar allt från planering, design och installation till service, drift och underhåll. Med två egna nätövervakningscentraler (NOC) och fälttekniker över hela landet kan vi både övervaka och säkerställa driften i ditt nät under dygnets alla timmar.
Våra kunder är exempelvis kommuner, teleoperatörer, nätägare, företag och offentlig förvaltning.

Name: Netmore
Description: Netmore Group is the leading global network operator for Massive IoT, powering the world’s most advanced and sustainability-focused solutions for utilities, buildings, cities, and other markets that benefit from sensor-connected environments. With a decade of innovation and leadership in IoT platform development and network operations, Netmore continues to set the standard for IoT excellence. Netmore operates in 18 countries and is backed by Nordic infrastructure investor Polar Structure.

Name: Qamcom
Description:
Qamcom Research and Technology provides product development and specialist consultancy services within Wireless Connectivity, Autonomous Systems and Industrial IoT and we want to be the desired technology partner to our customers and research partners. We work with stimulating, challenging and state-of-the-art technology and by incorporating it in to solutions and products for our customers we want to provide value to them as well as to the world. 

We believe that the best way to bring value into products and solutions is to combine creativity and deep knowledge. Our way of creating such environment is to combine people with research education and strong industry experience together with flexible and novel approaches to technology development, business engineering and how we work and organise ourselves.

Our ambition is to attract the best R&D experts in our core domains and provide services ranging from customer on-site assignments to in-house turnkey product development projects handling everything from feasibility studies to finished products and modules.

We are engaged in national and international research programs and we engage ourselves in all aspects of R&D ranging from design and algorithm development to product portfolio discussions, system definitions, technology management and complete product development.

Qamcom Research and Technology has offices in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Linköping, Wellington (New Zealand) and Greensboro (US).

Name: Wellness TechGroup
Description:
Wellness TechGroup is a technology company with 12 years of experience in the development and implementation of Communications and Cloud, IoT, Cybersecurity, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence solutions and specialized in multi-vertical projects that cover the design, manufacture, implementation and operation of solutions that make up models of Sustainable Cities, Safe Cities, Smart Destinations and Connected Industry.

The company uses its Smart technology to overcome the challenges facing cities, regions, public services and industry. It currently has deployments in more than 400 cities and 60 countries around the world.

It has 100 employees and has an international presence and offices and branches in Spain, Mexico, the United States, Sweden, Germany and Australia.

Its IRIS Sentinel brand addresses comprehensive cybersecurity projects in the Smart world for cities and organizations and WTS Horizon is its division for Sustainable Development projects in the public and private sectors.

Name: Rebtel
Description:
Rebtel is a consumer communications company built for dual-culture people—immigrants, expats, and international students who live between cultures. We offer reliable, competitively-priced international calling to mobiles and landlines with flexible payment structures, including pay-as-you-go and country-specific unlimited subscriptions. 

Rebtel’s users value transparency, low friction, and support in local languages and currencies—these needs create the core of its brand and pricing. The company’s go-to-market is direct-to-consumer with targeted performance channels and community partnerships. Its revenue scales with credits and subscriptions, with promotions driving efficient trials and retention. Rebtel differentiates itself with clear value vs. carrier rates, simple UX, multilingual support, and the trust it has built in migrant communities over the past two decades.

Name: Maven Wireless
Description:
Maven Wireless is a leading innovator in wireless coverage solutions, particularly Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS). Our products enable our customers to maximise the bandwidth and capacity of their wireless infrastructure with excellent RF performance and data throughput. 

Maven Wireless patented technology offers unrivalled energy efficiency, radically bringing down the total cost of ownership. 

Maven Wireless products are engineered for easy installation, with automatic configuration to reduce commissioning time.  The platform is prepared with capacity for future upgrades to for instance 5G and has architectural support for C-RAN. 

The members of Maven Wireless have been pioneers since the early days of repeaters and have integral knowledge within the field of wireless coverage products.

Maven Wireless corporate headquarters are located in Stockholm, Sweden with a partner network across various regions.

Name: Satcube
Description:
Satcube is a disruptive development company in the satellite communications arena that manufactures game-changing portable satellite terminals to enable high-performance broadband - anywhere on the planet, quickly and cost-effectively. Satcube provides seamless broadband connectivity over satellite through easy to use, lightweight terminals. The innovative Satcube Ku terminal is a highly compact, user-friendly device that delivers quick connectivity empowering people at work, businesses and global organizations, to communicate and deliver critical services at any time. 

The Satcube solution is designed for broadcast media companies, emergency response, law enforcement, public safety organizations, tele-medicine, NGO ́s, industry and those with remote work locations and high capacity communications needs - without any need for engineering expertise. 

Satcube is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with a global network of strategic resellers.

Name: Sunway Communication
Description:
Sunway Communication is a world leading provider of RF connectivity related and other performance-critical components and modules. The company involves in all stages of the product value chain: research, development, sales and manufacturing. The parent company, Shenzhen Sunway Communication Co., Ltd, was established on April 27, 2006 and was successfully listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in November 2010 (stock code: 300136). The main products of Sunway are Antennas, Wireless Charging modules and Soft Magnetic Materials, RF front-end components, EMC/EMI solutions, Cables and Connectors, Audio/RF modules and more.
 
Sunway has collaborated and established strategic corporate relationships and professional services for our customers in applications such as Consumer Electronics (smartphones, tablets, PCs, smart wearable devices etc.), Automotive, IoT, Smart Home and Communication Infrastructure.

In order to provide its customers with efficient service, Sunway has established eleven R&D and sales centers in Shenzhen, Shanghai, Beijing,  Xi'an, Changzhou, Mianyang, Taipei, the United States, Sweden, Korea, and Japan and four manufacturing centers in Shenzhen, Beijing, Changzhou and Vietnam. Additionally, three advanced research centers are located in China (Shenzhen), Japan (Shin-Yokohama) and Sweden (Stockholm) focusing on future technology research.

Our proud team of committed Sunway employees always goes the extra mile to provide state-of-the-art product R&D and technology support to our global customer base.

Name: Doro Group
Description: Doro is a leading technology brand for seniors developing consumer products and services to support an active and independent life. By using technology, Doro enable generations to connect digitally – both while at home and when out and about. Doro is a Swedish company listed on Stockholm Nasdaq Stock Exchange. The company is headquartered in Malmö and has sales operations in 27 countries. In 2021, Doro’s Consumer operations had 116 employees and net sales amounted to SEK 1 039.6 million (EUR 102 million), making it the European market leader for senior specialized mobile phones. Read more about Doro on our website www.doro.com

Name: Com Hem AB

Name: Bluetest AB
Description:
Bluetest develops and manufactures reverberations chambers and software, for fast and cost effective development and evaluation of wireless products using small antennas. Bluetest is a rapidly growing company with a state of the art test method for all wireless devices with small antennas. The tests, for important end-user parameters such as coverage, throughput, and battery lifetime, are very fast and cost effective compared to traditional measurement systems. Bluetest has a globally spread distributor network and reverberation test systems installed on many locations at various sites around the world.
There are today no other test systems than reverberation chambers where the performance of MIMO antennas can be directly measured and Bluetest is today the world leader in MIMO OTA (Over The Air) testing. The RTS65 and the RTS95 systems are the fast, cost effective, and physically smaller than alternative solutions. Measurements can be performed up to ten times faster. For terminals with multiple antennas the reverberation system is the only instrument to directly measure diversity gain and MIMO capacity.

Bluetest's main customers are mobile phone manufacturers, operators, IoT companies, developers of small antennas. However, all companies working with wireless devices, e.g. Bluetooth modules, WLAN, IoT wireless sensors, etc., will be able to speed up their development time and improve the performance of their products using a Bluetest system.

Name: CellMax Technologies
Description:
CellMax Technologies develops and markets ultra-high efficiency base station antennas for mobile networks. CellMax’s revolutionary antenna technology reduces the power losses within the antenna to close to zero, resulting in higher signal strength and a dramatic increase in geographical area coverage, improved indoor penetration, increased net traffic, improved data throughput and reduced production costs per call.
 
CellMax’s unique and patented antenna design is based on quasi waveguide technology with air as dielectric, which virtually eliminates power losses; Traditional antennas lose 20-60 percent power through the cables. With CellMax’s antennas, mobile operators can reduce the power consumption in their radio networks by up to 30 percent – or use the same amount of power to improve network performance.

Description:
About Waystream
Waystream AB, located in Kista, Sweden, is a leading Swedish provider of active equipment for fiber to the home networks (FTTx). We develop network products for communication over fiber that are reliable, easy to operate and deliver great services. This enables our customers to build network faster, more robustly and with better return on investments. All Waystream switches have a build-in solution for Telemetry. What later became Waystream was founded in 2001 with the vision Communication Everywhere! The Company share is listed on Nasdaq First North under the name WAYS. Waystream ́s Certified Advisor is FNCA Sweden AB. Read more and visit www.waystream.com
 
Product and solutions portfolio 
Waystream sells Gigabit To The Home (GTTH) routers and switches to network operators in Layer 2 and Layer 3 broadband networks and has installations in multiple countries. 
Our product portfolio consists of switches and routers for broadband networks. We blend network processor and wire-speed hardware in our products to achieve a new level of functionality through software. Therefore, our products can be deployed for longer time, be upgraded to meet new challenges and changes in network and user behavior and provide you with new tools and new functionality. We were the first vendor to introduce streaming telemetry data and to introduce service assurance features such as multicast TV quality control and connectivity measurement in access-switches for fiber networks. These unique features give our customers a deeper insight into the network operation, faster troubleshooting and better control over the services provided to the end-users.

Name: Stokab
Description:
Stokab provides a dark fibre connection between two requested addresses on the fibre network. Either the customer activates the connection using their own telecom equipment or they purchase capacity from, any of the more than 100 active operators who already exist in the network. The fixed monthly fee for the connection is the same, regardless of the capacity set in the customer's equipment.
Telecom operators, businesses, local authorities and organisations can lease dark fibre from Stokab. In addition to fibre optics, Stokab provides space in nodes and/or hubs in which customers can install communication equipment needed to connect their own networks to those of others.

Name: OCIUSNET
Description:
OCIUSNET GROUP AB is a complete end to end provider for Fiber Network Deployment services, from Business Planning/Consulting, Engineering design to Network Roll-out under full Program/Project Management. By focusing on innovation and using the most technologically advanced solutions, OCIUSNET will reduce implementation costs and shorten the time to market for our customers.

OCIUSNET is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with local subsidiaries in selected markets, all missioned to help our customers 'Experience Broadband Faster'.

Contact@ociusnetgroup.com

Name: Netrounds
Description:
Netrounds provides innovative software that empowers telecom operators with capabilities to innovate, deploy and operate networks and services with assured end-user experience, using less operational staff. 

Netrounds gives network professionals in-depth end-to-end knowledge of network performance and service quality, and the ability to prevent and troubleshoot problems effectively. Netrounds is privately owned with offices in Luleå, Sweden and Boston, MA.

Name: Boom Collaboration
Description:
Boom Collaboration makes video conferencing hardware for every meeting room.
Cameras, speakerphones, and all-in-one conferencing devices that work on any platform, deploy in minutes, and don't require an IT specialist to support. Plug in and meet.

Boom products cover the full range of modern meeting spaces. Huddle rooms, home offices, boardrooms, classrooms, healthcare facilities, and everything in between. Every product is platform-agnostic, Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Webex, and built for the way teams actually work today.

Simple to deploy. Easy to support. Ready for whatever platform your team prefers.
Channel-first. Distributed globally through AV resellers, integrators, and distributors.

Better Meetings. Simply.

Find us at boom.co

Name: Swedish Telecom
Description:
Swedish Telecom is a leading telecommunications consultancy, pioneering innovative solutions across the globe. We specialize in network infrastructure, change management, IoT smart cities, and data center optimization, catering to operators, system integrators, and vertical companies in the IoT space. Our mission is to empower businesses with cutting-edge technologies and strategic insights, ensuring they stay ahead in the fast-evolving digital landscape.

Proudly incorporating daughter companies Swedish Telecom OPTO and HNR.ai, we're at the forefront of next-generation tech. Swedish Telecom OPTO delivers superior fiber optical modules and DWDM filters, enhancing data transmission and network efficiency. HNR.ai focuses on Hyper-Network Reality (HNR) and AI, ML, WEB3, 6G and beyond to revolutionize connectivity and operations in a hyper-connected world.

Our commitment to innovation and quality service positions Swedish Telecom as a key player in driving digital transformation. Join us in shaping the future of telecommunications.

Name: Cellnex Sweden
Description:
Cellnex Sweden was formed in July 2020, and initially named Hi3G Networks, after the acquisition of Hi3G Access’ (Three) tower and rooftop sites.  The headquarter is located in Stockholm, and the site portfolio is distributed over the entire country, ranging from 72 meter towers to highly technical indoor systems, providing operators with cost efficient and environmental friendly installation sites.

Cellnex Sweden (On Tower Sweden) is an independent tower company and part of Cellnex Telecom, Europe’s leading operator of wireless communications, with operations in 12 countries. We offer a variety of towers, rooftop sites and other structures for housing of equipment for wireless communications. Across Sweden, the company operates more than 2,500 sites, and is a full range service provider of rollout and site optimisation services as well as operation and maintenance.

Cellnex Sweden is a co-location partner for all major wireless operators in Sweden. The company provide safe and well maintained sites for mobile operators, broadcasting, IoT, wifi and fibre operators. Our ambition is to grow faster than the market, while providing flexible and innovative services at an attractive price level.

Our mission is to bring value for society, customers and shareholders, and all stakeholders, through innovative, efficient, neutral and quality management for the provision of shared telecommunications networks and infrastructure through the drive and development of our staff team.

Name: Vimla
Description:
We're Vimla, Sweden’s most annoying mobile carrier. We annoy our competitors by creating new things because new things are annoying to the people who like old things. We are the trendsetters, the changemakers, the chakemangers and the cakebakers.

Since we launched in 2014 we have learned a lot. We have learned that it feels better to donate some of our profits to charity. That having Sweden’s most loyal customers (and the best customer service) is a great way to grow really fast, and that we become a lot better if we create our services together with our customers.

We are so proud of our achievements so far, but wow. We just getting started friend. Oh yes. Fingers crossed. Break a leg.

You joining?

Name: CueDee AB
Description:
WELCOME to CueDee
QUALITY DESIGN SINCE 1978

CueDee has since 1978 developed technical solutions and innovations for the TELECOM INDUSTRY. In the very beginning the manufacturing was mainly radio amateurs antennas, but later CueDee focused more and more on adjustable antenna support structures.

IN 1989 CueDee LAUNCHED a new type of antenna support system including the Aluscopic light weight aluminium mast. The Aluscopic mast was designed to carry antennas on top of roofs and was immediate a great success because of its weight, size and strength was optimized for the new type of mobile networks GSM.

QUALITY DESIGN IS AND HAS always been a key word within CueDee , to optimize the design due to material, strength, weight, function and logistics is for us a matter of pride.

This has been proven both by the many international patents we have achieved and also by the number of global leading telecom companies that we can count as our customers today.

Name: lynes
Description: lynes is not just a great collaboration tool for your business. Or a awesome phone system. lynes is both. It allows you to hold video meetings, receive calls, chat with colleagues and customers and share documents - all in the same workflow. lynes is also developed in Sweden and has Swedish support, which is never further away than a push of a button.

Name: Halebop
Description: Halebops målgrupp lever en stor del av sitt liv online, via mobilen. Vi är 19 eldsjälar som brinner för att ta fram schyssta erbjudanden och erbjuda kunderna den bästa upplevelsen online. Det här med schyssthet är viktigt för oss. Vi är övertygade om att världen skulle vara en mycket bättre plats om alla var snällare mot varandra. Därför genomsyrar schyssthet allt vi gör. Våra erbjudanden är utan lockpriser och fineprints, vi låter kunderna skicka fria sms till alla på hela jordklotet och prata oändligt länge i telefonen. Dessutom får de surfa supersnabbt i ett riktigt bra nät (Telias). Men bäst av allt är nog att vi har en support som är öppen mellan 8-22 alla dagar, till och med på självaste julafton. Vi stöttar också kampen mot näthat och i höstas gjorde vi till exempel en omfattande kampanj tillsammans med NoHate Speechmovement. Kort och gott, förutom att erbjuda riktigt prisvärda abonnemang och mobilpaketeringar handlar allt vi gör i vårt företag om att förenkla för kunden och dessutom göra det vi kan för att visa att nätet är en plats som ger oss möjlighet att vara schysst.

Name: Net4Mobility
Description:
Net4Mobility is a joint venture between Telenor Sweden and Tele2 Sweden, with the mission to build, own and operate a nationwide mobile network.

The mobile network covers 99% of the Swedish population and enables Telenor and Tele2 to offer their customers leading data and voice services (5G NR/LTE/UMTS/GSM).

Net4Mobility was founded in April 2009 and operates in the 700, 800, 900, 1800, 2600 and 3500 MHz frequency bands.

Name: Competella,  an Enghouse Interactive solution
Description:
We have Microsoft Teams in the DNA of our products

In June 2022 Competella AB was acquired by Enghouse Systems Limited and Competella’s products is aligned with the Enghouse Interactive Group’s product offerings. 

Competella is a complete Cloudbased contact center platform created to enhance the offerings of Microsoft Teams. The Competella Communication Suite is Certified for Teams and includes solutions for contact centers and attendants and is fully integrated with Microsoft Teams.
Our aim is to improve and optimize the communication between businesses (our clients) and their customers by developing a modular multi-media channeling solution – the Competella CS (Communication Suite). With our Communications Suite we help customers migrate from their legacy PBX in their own pace to Microsoft Teams and the Competella CS.

The companies which use the Competella solutions carry on business within various industries in both the public and private sector – our more than 700 customers vary in size from around 100 employees to 100,000 employees globally.

Name: Swedish Wireless Innovation Network (SweWIN)
Description: SweWIN is a Vinnova-sponsored Competence Center that focuses on making future wireless technology more sustainable, resilient, and fair. The center brings together academia, research institutes, enterprises, and society to enhance research, innovation, and education. The founding members are KTH Royal Institute of Technology, RISE, Ericsson, Saab, ABB, Cellmax, Beammwave, and Northern Waves. The director is Emil Björnson and the vice director is Cicek Cavdar, both professors at KTH.

Name: Dialect AB
Description:
Vi levererar it- och telekommunikation och hittar alltid lösningar så att du kan arbeta bäst där du är. Vi ser till att allt kan fungera ihop – oavsett tid, plats eller lösning. 

Med integrerade lösningar erbjuder vi dig säkra och effektiva arbetsplatser oavsett om du jobbar hemifrån, på kontoret eller i bilen. Lösningarna innefattar bland annat mobil och fast telefoni, molntjänster, dokument- och datatjänster, mötestjänster, installation och support. Med stort engagemang och brett kunnande kan vi ta ansvar för helheten. Vi står också oberoende av marknadens leverantörer och operatörer.

Dialect bildades i augusti 1995 under gemensamt varumärke. Idag är vi en rikstäckande kedja som drivs av koncernen Dialect AB. Vi är 650 anställda och omsatte en miljard kronor under 2013. Huvudkontoret finns i Solna och med våra 50 kundcenter är vi etablerade i alla delar av landet, från Boden till Malmö.

Policy för Dialect AB:s sidor i sociala medier: http://dialect.se/sida/policy-dialects-sidor-pa-facebook-linkedin-och-twitter

Name: ESTEL
Description:
At ESTEL, we are dedicated to designing and manufacturing cutting-edge optical transceivers in Europe. We are unleashing the power of high-speed optical communication for critical applications as supercomputers, HPC, telecommunications and satellite communication. Thanks to our experienced R&D team and our production line we are able to design and build the custom solutions needed for your high speed network applications. 

As a key player, we aim to build a strong ecosystem to bring back sovereignty and sustainability to the market. Quality and production capacity are key factors for success, therefore we've automated our processes of our production line to increase efficiency and reduce costs in a highly competitive sector.

We pride ourselves on designing optical solutions that are highly-efficient and stable, featuring low-power consumption and which comply with EU cybersecurity (CRA) and EU sourcing directives to meet the demands of modern communication networks.

Name: Tykoflex AB
Description:
Since 1958, Tykoflex has delivered Swedish-engineered connections for critical infrastructure. Made for absolute reliability and adaptable to any environment.

Our robust, future-proof solutions are trusted across the entire connectivity ecosystem, from the ocean floor to urban centers. With a legacy in flexible pipe couplings and decades of expertise in fiber closures, we design for zero downtime, extreme durability, and maximum efficiency, minimizing lifetime costs and maximizing peace of mind.

All development and manufacturing take place in Tyresö, Sweden. Since 2022, Tykoflex is a proud member of Lagercrantz Group AB, Electrify division.

Name: Scalado
Description:
Scalado - One more reason to love your phone

Scalado is a world leader in the mobile imaging industry, with a long history of developing innovative platform-independent imaging solutions. Based on Scalado’s unique Random Access JPEG and more than 50 patent and patent pending technologies, these innovations are currently being used by the world’s leading global telecom and platform players in over 1 billion mobile devices, a figure that is growing with over 500 million devices each year.

Since the start, the company’s mission has been to help camera and mobile phone manufacturers to significantly improve their imaging solutions in order to deliver an optimal end-user experience. Scalado helps companies shorten their time-to-market and differentiate their products through imaging solutions that offer top of the line advantages in editing, enhancing, viewing and sending images.

Scalado’s technology has gained worldwide recognition by all of the major players in the IT industry. The company already licenses its solutions to the top five tier 1 mobile phone manufacturers, top 10 ISP/Sensor companies, and most leading platform providers. As a result, when someone is using a camera phone, it’s very likely that Scalado’s patented imaging platform is onboard.

Scalado has offices in Sweden (HQ), Korea, China, Taiwan, Singapore and the United States. The company employs around 110 people, most of them working at its Swedish HQ in Lund.

Name: Emblasoft
Description:
We are a global provider of Service Enablement, Performance Management, and Test and Verification systems for VoLTE, IMS , 3G, 4G and 5G infrastructure.

With Emblasoft, operators and equipment manufacturers benefit from new products and services, based on the very latest technologies and standards, validated and supported by outstanding assurance.

At Emblasoft, we’re passionate about developing and delivering software solutions that enable our customers to innovate and to drive the evolution of their networks.

Name: We Consulting AB
Description:
WE CONSULTING REPRESENTS A NEW BREED OF CONSULTING COMPANIES. We operate in the network infrastructure industry and help our clients design, operate, own and use networks for telecommunication and power transmission.

Whether the goal is to maximize revenue, provide the best quality or reduce cost, our experience combined with our Nordic presence help our clients succeed.

We are proud to serve the biggest network operators in both Sweden and Norway on a daily basis. 

Our Philosophy
Our founding partners know the telecommunications industry by heart and have a vast experience of running a consulting business.They bring important insights about what makes a consulting agency successful – and what could be holding it back. We Consulting derived from a strong wish to create a company where strategic and operating decisions benefit the long term progress of it’s people, clients and business, rather than maximising quarterly profit. 

Joy, simplicity and sustainability shape our culture and organisation and we will never let that turn into a corporate cliché. Having happy employees and happy clients is something we take seriously! 

We Consulting is present in Karlstad, Oslo, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Jönköping, Sundsvall, Luleå, Stockholm and Gothenburg. Want to work with us or join us? Let us know! Take a look at the contact info below or visit our website for your local contacts.
You can also follow us on:
instagram.com/weconsulting
twitter.com/weconsultingab
facebook.com/weconsultingab

Name: Tre Partner Communication
Description:
Hej! Vi är Trecom.

Tillsammans är vi ett entreprenörsdrivet, personligt och nytänkande telekombolag. Vi samarbetar med samtliga svenska operatörer för att ge våra kunder största möjliga valfrihet, enkelhet och bästa lösning till rätt pris.

Vi är en tillgång för hundratals företag och förenklar vardagen för tusentals användare varje dag. Genom våra tre fokusområden: telefoni, digitala körjournaler och wowservice – tar vi helhetsansvar och hanterar allt från förhandling och utbildning till support för våra kunder. Vår vision är att bli din kompletta leverantör inom kommunikation, fordon och IT-lösningar. Vi är kreativa, kompetenta och erfarna, och vi vet hur viktig service är för att våra kunder ska bli riktigt nöjda.

Kontakta oss så berättar vi mer om hur Trecom kan hjälpa ditt företag till en bättre helhetslösning!

Name: Upfront AB
Description: Välkommen till en kommunikationsleverantör som gör ert liv som företag mer kontrollerat. Tillsammans har vi över 200 års erfarenhet och stor spetskompetens inom Telekom.

Name: Zenterio AB
Description:
We want to reimagine TV.

Zenterio enables TV Operators to securely and efficiently manage and deliver entertainment to the home while increasing business insight and value. Zenterio’s portfolio of products and solutions includes a complete TV and OTT entertainment experience client. In addition, Zenterio provides cloud-based solutions for content aggregation, data and analytics, home automation integrations and advanced advertising capabilities with a focus on reducing cost and increasing ARPU.  Zenterio also provides professional and consulting services, with global partners, to provide future-proofed lifecycle management for Linux and Android platforms.
Our offices are in Linköping, Atlanta and Dublin. We are owned by private investors and the private equity firm Scope. 

The Chairman of the Board is former Nokia CEO Olli-Pekka Kallasvuo and the CEO is former Ericsson executive Jorgen Nilsson.

Name: 84 Grams AB
Description: 84 Grams levererar bredbandstjänster uteslutande till företag. Det innebär inga långa telefonköer, trängsel med privatpersoner eller omvägar via supportrobotar – utan direktkontakt med experter som förstår dina behov. Oavsett om du behöver stabil uppkoppling till kontoret, en skräddarsydd punkt-till-punkt-lösning eller avancerat DDoS-skydd, finns vi här med lösningar som är pålitliga, säkra och byggda för verksamhetskritisk användning.
